tier: App Automate Device Cloud (annual, 1 parallel test)

free_tier.stated: A free trial includes 100 minutes of automated mobile application testing on different mobile devices, plus 30 minutes each of interactive browser and mobile app testing and 5000 screenshots/month for visual testing with Percy.
free_tier.notes: The trial is a sign-up offer, not a recurring free plan. Paid App Automate Device Cloud is USD 199 per month billed annually for 1 parallel test (USD 249 month-to-month).

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: the unit is a device test session, not a stored object

retention.stated: Test-session duration is capped by the trial minutes and by the idle session timeout; no object retention is published.

egress.terms: No egress volume allowance or per-GB price for test traffic is published on the pricing or FAQ pages. IP whitelisting for inbound and outbound traffic is an enterprise-add-on feature.

interface_detail: Appium, Espresso, XCUITest, Maestro and Flutter test frameworks drive sessions on real devices; the pricing comparison lists a REST API for test status, session info and logs, plus CI/CD and workflow integrations.
tooling: An Appium, Espresso, XCUITest, Maestro or Flutter test suite, SDK plugins and CI/CD integrations; a REST API for test status and logs.
chaining: An automated mobile test suite runs against a cloud device lab in CI, with a REST API for results and local testing for staging endpoints; logs and reports stay in the BrowserStack dashboard.

limits.value: 100 minutes of automated mobile application testing on different mobile devices in the free trial; paid tier billed per parallel test, 1 parallel test at USD 199/month annually
1 parallel test at the entry paid tier; 2, 5 or more than 5 parallel tests at higher tiers

limits_note: Unlimited testing minutes on paid plans, subject to fair usage on certain Automate plans; idle sessions time out.
binding_note: The 100 trial minutes are the first constraint an unregistered evaluation exhausts; after sign-up the entry paid tier's 1 parallel test is the binding constraint.

identity_cost.detail: The sign-up page offers 'Sign up with Google' and an email-and-password form with an optional role and discovery question; no card, phone number or ID document is requested at sign-up.

reliability_note: Certain Automate plans are subject to fair usage; idle sessions time out and paid plans meter parallel tests.
confidence_note: The rate, parallel-test tiers and features come from the first-party pricing page, the 100 trial minutes from the first-party FAQ, and the registration fields from the first-party sign-up page read on 2026-11-24; the raw signup form input labels were not exposed to the page reader, so the exact email field wording is unverified.
